en: Wearing glittering armor,
The strongest dragon warrior -
From "Digimon Adventure", Figure-rise Standard Amplified War Greymon,
Appears in a luxurious specification with gold and silver plating on the whole body armor, as well as metallic molding color and glitter clear color.
◆ Luxurious two-color plating
The characteristic armor that covers the entire body pursues a sense of density and solidity through gold and silver matte plating.
The red part uses metallic molding color.
◆ Adopts lame clear purple
The inside of the back shell, which can be expanded like wings, is molded in a special lame clear purple color.
◆ Balances movement and proportions
Bold action poses are possible.
◆ Delivered in full color PKG!
